purpose: Reference knowledge base for AI face-scan analysis. Match detected symptoms to the most relatable skin issue(s) using weighted matching, then return a detailed but simple explanation, a daily homemade routine with tutorial, a recommended product, and an optional weekly-only routine.

matching_logic.instructions: Each issue has a list of symptoms with a weight (1.0 = strong indicator, 0.5 = supporting indicator). Sum the weights of matched symptoms per issue. The issue(s) with the highest total score are the primary matches. Multiple issues can be returned if scores are close (within 20% of the top score) since skin can have overlapping problems.

global_disclaimer: Skn Lab provides general skincare guidance based on visual analysis and is not a medical diagnosis. If symptoms are severe, painful, spreading, or not improving after 4-6 weeks, please see a licensed dermatologist.

skin_issues.name: Acne & Breakouts
skin_issues.issue_description: Your pores are getting clogged with oil, dead skin, and bacteria, causing breakouts. This is usually driven by excess oil production, hormones, or a buildup of dead skin cells that traps bacteria under the surface.
skin_issues.solving_approach: Focus on gentle exfoliation, oil control, and antibacterial care without over-drying the skin, which can trigger even more oil production.

weekly_routine.title: Turmeric & Yogurt Antibacterial Mask (1x per week)
weekly_routine.steps: Mix the turmeric powder with plain yogurt into a smooth paste. Apply evenly to clean face, avoiding the eye area. Leave for 15-20 minutes to let the antibacterial and exfoliating properties absorb. Rinse off with warm water.

skin_issues.disclaimer: If acne is cystic, painful, or leaving deep scars, see a dermatologist — this may need prescription treatment.

pm_product_recommendation.why: A targeted overnight treatment that kills acne-causing bacteria directly at the source, working while you sleep.

am_product_recommendation.why: Gently unclogs pores each morning without over-drying.

skin_issues.routine_consistency_rule: AM routine = am_homemade_routine + am_product_recommendation. PM routine = pm_homemade_routine + pm_product_recommendation. This exact pairing repeats identically every day of the 30-day plan for this matched issue. Do not rotate, swap, or alternate between AM and PM routines on different days.

pm_homemade_routine.title: Honey & Oatmeal Calming Mask
pm_homemade_routine.steps: Blend oats into a fine powder, mix with honey and a little warm water into a paste, apply to clean face, leave 10 minutes, rinse with warm water.

am_homemade_routine.title: Green Tea Ice Cube Wipe
am_homemade_routine.steps: Freeze brewed green tea into ice cubes overnight. Each morning, rub one cube gently over the face for 30-60 seconds to reduce redness and control oil before cleansing.

skin_issues.name: Dryness & Dehydration
skin_issues.issue_description: Your skin's moisture barrier is depleted, meaning it's losing water faster than it can retain it. This can happen from harsh cleansers, weather, or not using enough hydrating layers.
skin_issues.solving_approach: Rebuild the moisture barrier with humectants (draw in water) and occlusives (lock it in) rather than heavy exfoliation.

weekly_routine.title: Avocado & Honey Moisture Mask (1x per week)

skin_issues.disclaimer: Persistent dryness with cracking or bleeding skin may indicate eczema — consult a dermatologist.

pm_product_recommendation.why: Hyaluronic acid holds up to 1000x its weight in water, pulling moisture into the skin.

am_product_recommendation.why: Cleanses without stripping moisture, essential for a compromised barrier.

pm_homemade_routine.title: Rice Water Hydrating Toner
pm_homemade_routine.steps: Rinse rice, soak in water for 30 minutes, strain the milky water into a bottle, apply with a cotton pad after cleansing morning and night.

am_homemade_routine.title: Rice Water Hydrating Toner
am_homemade_routine.steps: Rinse rice, soak 30 minutes, strain the milky water into a bottle, apply with a cotton pad after cleansing each morning.

skin_issues.name: Oily Skin & Excess Sebum
skin_issues.issue_description: Your sebaceous glands are producing more oil than your skin needs, often due to genetics, hormones, or over-stripping your skin (which can trigger it to overproduce oil to compensate).
skin_issues.solving_approach: Balance oil production with gentle, non-stripping cleansers and mattifying, oil-absorbing ingredients — avoid harsh alcohol-based products.

weekly_routine.title: Bentonite Clay Oil-Control Mask (1x per week)

skin_issues.disclaimer: None — oily skin is a normal skin type, not a medical concern, though excessive oiliness with pain may need medical review.

pm_product_recommendation.why: Niacinamide regulates oil production and minimizes the look of pores over time.

am_product_recommendation.why: Removes excess overnight oil without disrupting the skin barrier.

skin_issues.name: Redness & Sensitivity
skin_issues.issue_description: Your skin barrier is likely compromised or reactive, causing inflammation to show on the surface as redness. This can be triggered by weather, harsh products, or a naturally sensitive skin type.
skin_issues.solving_approach: Use only gentle, fragrance-free, anti-inflammatory ingredients. Avoid actives like retinol or strong acids until redness calms.

weekly_routine.title: Aloe Vera Calming Mask (1x per week)

skin_issues.disclaimer: Persistent redness with bumps or visible blood vessels may be rosacea — please see a dermatologist for proper diagnosis, as home remedies alone won't resolve it.

pm_product_recommendation.why: Cica is known for calming inflammation and repairing a damaged skin barrier.

am_product_recommendation.why: Cleanses without triggering further irritation or stripping the barrier.

skin_issues.name: Hyperpigmentation & Dark Spots
skin_issues.issue_description: Extra melanin is being produced in certain areas, usually left over from healed acne, sun exposure, or inflammation. This fades over time but can be sped up with the right ingredients.
skin_issues.solving_approach: Focus on gentle brightening ingredients and consistent SPF use, since sun exposure makes dark spots darker and slower to fade.

weekly_routine.title: Papaya Enzyme Brightening Mask (1x per week)

skin_issues.disclaimer: Daily SPF is essential — without it, dark spots won't fade and can get worse.

pm_product_recommendation.why: Vitamin C inhibits excess melanin production and brightens existing dark spots over time.

am_product_recommendation.why: Preps skin each morning to better absorb brightening actives.
